user.title: ESO account
user.description: Enter your mano.eso.lt credentials. Leave the IMAP host blank to enter the login code manually in the UI.

tfa.title: Enter ESO code
tfa.description: Enter the one-time code ESO emailed you.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate ESO
reauth_confirm.description: Confirm your ESO password (edit it if it changed). ESO will email a fresh login code.

reauth_code.title: Re-enter ESO code
reauth_code.description: ESO emailed a new login code. Enter it to refresh access.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check your username and password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach ESO. Try again later.
error.invalid_code: That code was not accepted. Check your email and try again.
error.code_expired: The code window expired. We emailed a new code — enter it below.

abort.already_configured: This ESO account is already set up.
abort.reauth_failed: Re-authentication failed. Check the logs and try again.
abort.reauth_successful: Re-authentication was successful and data was refreshed.

error.duplicate_object: An object with this ID already exists on this account.
